name: Gakuen Caste ~Youmuin Gesuyama no Gyakuten Shihai Seikatsu~
original_name: 学園カースト ～用務員下衆山の逆転支配生活～
source: The prestigious all-girls school, St. Catherine Academy, is a home to beautiful girls from rich heiresses to sports elites who enjoy a peaceful campus life. However, there is a hidden hierarchy system, with the lowly janitor, Genshu Yamashita, reigning at the top. Even the beautiful principal is at the bottom of this caste system, dedicated to serving those above her. As a new school year begins, Yamashita starts searching for new targets, with the aim of training them as sex slaves by exploiting their weaknesses.
translation: 著名的女子学校圣凯瑟琳学院是美丽女孩的家园，从富有的女继承人到体育精英，她们享受着平静的校园生活。然而，这里存在着一个隐藏的等级制度，由低等的看门人山下源州统治着最高层。即使是美丽的校长也处于这个种姓制度的最底层，致力于为比她高的人服务。新学年开始，山下开始寻找新的目标，目的是利用他们的弱点将他们训练成性奴隶。
